scripts.check: npm run types:generate && npm run types:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:admin && npm run deploy:dry-run && npm run test:service-bindings
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run deploy:dry-run:core && npm run deploy:dry-run:publisher && npm run deploy:dry-run:rendezvous
scripts.types:generate: wrangler types worker-runtime.d.ts --include-env=false -c wrangler.jsonc && wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts --include-runtime=false -c wrangler.jsonc && wrangler types publisher-worker-configuration.d.ts --env-interface PublisherEnv --include-runtime=false -c wrangler.publisher.jsonc -c wrangler.jsonc && wrangler types rendezvous-worker-configuration.d.ts --env-interface RendezvousEnv --include-runtime=false -c wrangler.rendezvous.jsonc -c wrangler.jsonc
scripts.types:check: wrangler types worker-runtime.d.ts --include-env=false --check -c wrangler.jsonc && wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts --include-runtime=false --check -c wrangler.jsonc && wrangler types publisher-worker-configuration.d.ts --env-interface PublisherEnv --include-runtime=false --check -c wrangler.publisher.jsonc -c wrangler.jsonc && wrangler types rendezvous-worker-configuration.d.ts --env-interface RendezvousEnv --include-runtime=false --check -c wrangler.rendezvous.jsonc -c wrangler.jsonc
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.publisher.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.rendezvous.json --noEmit && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit
